description: Explore the codified Code of Federal Regulations via eCFR in three modes. "structure" lists all 50 titles; with a title, that title's top-level divisions (its chapters, or subtitles); and with a title and part, every section and appendix in the part, flattened and paged, each naming the subpart and subject group it sits under — the way to enumerate a part's sections without reading its text. "search" runs a full-text query across the codified CFR and returns matching sections with their hierarchy path and a snippet, one result per section, paged. "versions" lists the dates a part's or one section's text changed, oldest first per section, paged, with the latest amendment date; with changed_since, what changed across a title. Every mode accepts title and part to narrow the scope, and all three feed regulations_get_cfr_section — a version row's `date` reads that version. Every search result reports which corpus answered it — the synced local mirror or the live eCFR index — and what that corpus covers, in `source` and `sourceScope`.

changed_since.description: Versions mode: keep only versions published by an eCFR issue dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD). With title alone, lists what changed across the title. Ignored in other modes.

date.description: Point-in-time date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current. Structure mode uses it for the historical hierarchy, and rejects a date past the title's up-to-date date. Search mode matches only the section text in effect on that day, so a past date searches the CFR as it read then; eCFR indexes 2017-01-03 onward and rejects a date past its current index date. Ignored in versions mode, where each row carries its own date.

mode.description: "structure": list titles, a title's top-level divisions, or a part's sections and appendices, to find a cite. "search": full-text search the codified CFR for sections matching a phrase. "versions": list the dates a part's or section's text changed (title plus part or changed_since).

page.description: 1-based page of search results, of a part's listing in structure mode, or of versions (default 1); ignored by a structure listing above a part, which comes back whole. A truncation notice names the next page. Live eCFR search pages through its first 10,000 hits only, so a page starting past them is refused — narrow the query instead of paging deeper.

part.description: CFR part within the title, in every mode — structure mode lists every section and appendix in the part, flattened and paged by page/per_page; search mode restricts matches to text inside that part; versions mode lists the part's versions, appendices included. Requires title; a part on its own is rejected. Parts can be alphanumeric ("1203a", "16A") and are matched exactly once a leading "Part" or "Pt." is dropped, so pass the identifier as eCFR writes it — "58" ("Part 58" also reads as 58), not "058".

per_page.description: Rows per page — search results, nodes of a part's listing in structure mode, or versions (at least 1, default 20, capped at 50 with a notice).

query.description: Full-text search phrase (search mode, required in that mode). Ignored in structure and versions modes.

section.description: Versions mode: list one section's versions rather than its part's ("141.61"). Requires part. "61", "§ 141.61", "141.61(c)", and "40 CFR 141.61" resolve to the section, with a notice. Ignored in other modes.

title.description: CFR title number (1–50). Structure mode: omit to list all 50 titles; provide it alone to list the title's top-level divisions (chapters, or subtitles) — not the parts beneath them — or with part to list that part. Search mode: optional filter restricting matches to that title — e.g. 40 for environmental rules, 21 for food and drugs. Versions mode: required, with part or changed_since.

name: regulations_browse_cfr

countBasis.description: What a search totalCount counts. "sections": distinct sections and appendices, one per result row. "section_versions": eCFR's own hit count, which counts every indexed version of each section — an upper bound on the rows the query pages through, reported until the whole hit list has been read.

date.description: Resolved point-in-time date — the hierarchy snapshot (structure mode), or the day whose section text was searched (search mode).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_required`: mode="search" with no query phrase. `title_not_found`: Structure mode where eCFR publishes no tree for the title at that date (a reserved title, or a date before its coverage), or where the part is absent from the tree it does publish. `title_required_for_part`: A part was given with no title. Part identifiers repeat across titles, and eCFR rejects a part filter that names no title. `versions_scope_required`: Versions mode with no title; with a title but neither part nor changed_since; or with a section but no part. `conflicting_title`: Versions mode with section written as a full cite ("21 CFR 141.61") naming a different title than title. `date_out_of_range`: A date past what eCFR serves: in structure mode, past the title's up-to-date date; in search mode, outside the indexed window (before 2017-01-03, or past its current index date). `page_out_of_window`: A live search page that starts past the 10,000 hits eCFR pages through for one query. `upstream_unavailable`: eCFR returned a 5xx, timed out, or served an HTML error page (live path). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

latestAmendmentDate.description: Versions mode: the newest `date` across every listed version, not just this page; null when none matched.

nodes.description: Structure mode: the 50 titles, a title's top-level divisions, or this page of a part's sections and appendices in document order.

appendix.description: On an appendix node, the identifier to pass straight back as regulations_get_cfr_section's `appendix` input; null on every other node type. It is free-form prose, not a letter ("Schedule I to Part 789", "Special Federal Aviation Regulation No. 88"), so pass it verbatim rather than abbreviating it.

cfrCite.description: Assembled cite → regulations_get_cfr_section: "40 CFR 50.1" for a section ("14 CFR 241 § 25" for one numbered without its part), "Appendix A-1 to Part 50, Title 40" for an appendix. Null on a level with no read path (title, subtitle, chapter).

reserved.description: True when the node is reserved/empty.

subjectGroup.description: In a part listing, the heading of the subject group the node sits under (a group of sections inside a part or subpart); null when it sits in none, and on every node above a part.

subpart.description: In a part listing, the label of the subpart the node sits under ("Subpart A—General"); null when no subpart encloses it, and on every node above a part.

type.description: Node type: title, subtitle, or chapter above a part; section or appendix in a part listing. Treat an unknown type as passthrough.

notice.description: Guidance: per_page above its ceiling, the next page to request, a page past the end, an empty result, what the count means, or how a section was read.

page.description: The page served — of search results, a part's listing, or versions.

results.description: Matching CFR sections and appendices, this page, one row per section however many of its versions matched (search mode).

items.description: One matching CFR section or appendix.

appendix.description: On an appendix hit, the identifier to pass straight back as regulations_get_cfr_section's `appendix` input; null on a section hit. Always null on a mirror hit — the index holds section text only, so mirror-sourced results never match an appendix.

cfrCite.description: Assembled cite → regulations_get_cfr_section. A section hit cites the section ("40 CFR 51.190"); an appendix hit cites the appendix in eCFR's own form ("Appendix C to Part 58, Title 40"), not the part around it, since the part's sections do not contain the matched text.

heading.description: What the matched node is called — the section, appendix, or part heading. Distinct from cfrCite, which is where it lives.

hierarchyPath.description: Path down to the match. A live hit names the part it sits in — "Title 40 › Chapter I › Subchapter C › Part 51 — Requirements for Preparation, Adoption, and Submittal of Implementation Plans › § 51.190" — so the subject matter is readable without a second call. A mirror hit is structural only ("Title 14 › Part 25 › § 25.1043"): the index stores no level names. Check `source` before comparing paths across results.

section.description: Section identifier, or null when the match is an appendix or a whole part.

source.description: Provenance: the synced mirror index, or the live eCFR search API (search mode).

sourceScope.description: What the answering corpus covers — the mirror's title coverage, or the live index and the date it was read at — narrowed by whichever of title and part the call supplied (search mode). Read it before concluding a query found nothing.

totalCount.description: Total matches before pagination — search results (see countBasis for what they count), the nodes in a part's listing, or versions.

truncated.description: True when another page follows this one.

versions.description: Versions mode: this page of versions in eCFR order — document order by identifier, oldest first within each.

items.description: One version of a section or appendix.

cfrCite.description: Cite → regulations_get_cfr_section, as structure mode cites the same node.

date.description: Day this version took effect: pass it as regulations_get_cfr_section `date` to read it. A row dated before 2017-01-01 is the text in force when eCFR coverage begins, read at 2017-01-01. A removed row's date reads nothing; the previous row's date reads the last text.

heading.description: The section or appendix name, plain text.

identifier.description: Section number ("141.61"); on an appendix row, the identifier regulations_get_cfr_section takes as `appendix`, verbatim.

issueDate.description: The eCFR issue that published this version, which can postdate `date`; changed_since filters on it.

removed.description: True on the row that removed the section or appendix.

subpart.description: Subpart identifier ("G"), or null when in none.

substantive.description: False when eCFR flags the version as an editorial re-issue.

type.description: "section" or "appendix". Treat an unknown type as passthrough.

title: regulations_browse_cfr
